cohort: The study included 200 women aged 19-48 years with singleton pregnancies delivering spontaneously in Karachi, Pakistan, divided into cases (mothers of low birth weight preterm babies) and controls (mothers of normal birth weight babies).
finding: There was no association found between maternal chronic apical periodontitis and low birth weight preterm birth, though low birth weight preterm birth was associated with education level and family size.
birth_weight: Low birth weight preterm babies and normal birth weight babies
